REGRESSION EVIDENCE FOR THE CERTIFICATION. I re-ran my four independent oracle families against the current tree. All were first measured BEFORE the Epic 8 validation refactor - the change that removed per-node frame/support validation and produced the 59x crossnobis speedup. That refactor touched exactly the path these oracles exercise, and nothing outside the test suite had re-checked it.

Every value is identical to the pre-refactor measurement.

  A. SUPPORT INDEX (first measured pass 3, pre-refactor) - exact vs brute force on all six topologies:
       full isotropic, anisotropic 1x1.5x2.5, random 35% mask, two disconnected blocks,
       single axial slab, radius < spacing. All exact=TRUE, unchanged.

  B. UNION PAIR PATTERN (pass 3) - exact vs brute force, identical nonzero counts:
       full 33935, sparse 12059, slab 8844. Unchanged.

  C. METRIC COMPOSITION AND COMPONENT LAW (pass 7):
       a == w/sum(w)                                    0
       exact sum max|K_coh + K_cfg - K_eff|             0
       K_coh == a a^T / denominator                     0
       denominator == (1/W^2) sqrt(w)^T Sigma sqrt(w)   TRUE
       inverse_quadratic_mode retained_inverse_metric, factorization_count 0
       conservation: identity certifies, local precisions refuse, require() behaves
       All unchanged.

  D. RELATION_FIT vs BASE R (pass 5):
       residual_df 55 = n - rank                        exact
       effect_covariance vs C(Xw^T Xw)^-1 C^T           1.387779e-17   (identical to pass 5)
       residual_block vs qr.resid(qr(LX), LY)           1.44329e-15    (identical to pass 5)
       residual orthogonality max|Xw^T r|               1.111413e-14   (identical to pass 5)

  (The "subset read == full read" FALSE line is the known 1-ULP artefact of my identical() check from
   pass 5, numerically 1.1e-16. Not a regression.)

WHAT THIS SUPPORTS FOR THE REPORT: the validation refactor that took the scale gate from a 193% failure to a 6.9% pass is verified non-perturbing across four independent oracle families plus the crossnobis value itself, which I confirmed separately at 5.55e-17 against a base-R oracle and bitwise identical to its pre-optimization value. A 59x speedup that moves no number is a strong claim and it now has evidence behind it that does not come from the package own test suite.

This is the kind of statement the "numerically verified" tier of your validation vocabulary is for.
